safety_control.purpose: Read-only authorized local safety status; no door or gas actuation

interactive_inference.purpose: Fixed planner contract, not a model accuracy benchmark

sensor_batch.purpose: One aggregated sensor read per request; not million-device radio load

scope.latency: client HTTP wall clock, includes default server/event persistence/state whitelist
scope.models: fixed authorized fixture plans and bounded sleep services, NOT AI accuracy
scope.network: application delay/503/body-rate injection, NOT packet or physical 6G trace
scope.pairing: same configured workloads, measured health differs; no paired causal HTTP effects
scope.load: finite-client closed loop; generator scheduling excluded, no coordinated-omission correction
scope.memory: matrix memory injected, live stress memory unknown
scope.defaults: real _init_gateway and BridgeHandler, operator config overrides recorded
